title: Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way
description: Use this service request to report hazardous spills or debris blocking the public right-of-way to include driving or travel lanes of traffic. ** Freeways are the responsibility of Texas Dept. of Transportation (TXDOT). ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 12 hours.

observedQuestions.question: Was the spill caused by a Sanitation Truck?
Which lane is the debris in/blocking?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

conditionalInstructions.text: New Service Type Suggestion offers Sanitation Property Damage.

Please verify the debris/spillage is blocking the driving/travel lanes of traffic or public right of way causing a hazard. If litter/debris is on the grassy/dirt area alongside or within a highway/freeway, street or intersection please create a Median/Right of Way Maintenance SR - this work is performed by City crews and a private contractor.

pathCoverage: Both Sanitation Truck answers tried; Yes triggered alternate-service suggestion.
All four debris locations tried; Street and Freeway revealed direction and lane questions.
All eleven direction answers tried; no further fields.
All three contact-preference answers tried. Required fields filled with mock values and Continue advanced to Contact. No contact data entered.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for hazardous debris blocking a public right of way.
actions.why: Report hazardous spills or debris blocking a public right of way, street, alley, sidewalk, driving lane, or other travel lane. The 311 request form asks what debris is present, whether a Sanitation truck caused the spill, and, for street or freeway locations, the direction of travel and affected lane.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way" requests is not the directed route for nonblocking litter or debris on a grassy or dirt roadside area; freeway routing is ambiguous because the description for "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way" requests on the Dallas 311 website assigns responsibility to TxDOT while the 311 request form still offers Freeway as a location. If a Sanitation truck caused property damage, then submit a "Sanitation Property Damage" 311 request instead. If litter or debris is on a grassy or dirt area without blocking a travel lane, then submit a "Median/Right of Way Maintenance" 311 request instead. If the concern is on a freeway, then contact TxDOT.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Environmental Quality Concerns" > Choose "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Environmental Quality Concerns" > Choose "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way"

actions.tagline: Contact TxDOT about a hazardous spill or debris on a freeway.
actions.why: For hazardous debris or spillage on a freeway. The description for "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way" requests on the Dallas 311 website states that freeways are the responsibility of the Texas Department of Transportation.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for debris on a median or grassy right of way.
actions.why: For litter or debris on a grassy or dirt area alongside or within a highway, freeway, street, or intersection, instead of debris blocking a driving or travel lane. The Dallas 311 website directs people with debris in that location to Median/Right of Way Maintenance.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Median/Right of Way Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Median/Right of Way Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for property damage caused by a Sanitation truck.
actions.why: For property damage caused by a Sanitation truck. When people answer Yes to the Sanitation-truck question in the 311 request form, the Dallas 311 website suggests Sanitation Property Damage; the description for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests on the Dallas 311 website limits its use to property damage caused by sanitation trucks.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests is not to be used for spills without property damage; the description for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests on the Dallas 311 website limits this service to property damage caused by sanitation trucks.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"
